harness.guard_rule: every probe is wrapped in try/catch; a throwing probe records value=null plus .error and the run CONTINUES
harness.exit_code_semantics: external-process probes report the real process exit code; powershell-cmdlet probes report 0 on clean completion and null when the probe threw
harness.timeout_policy: each external process bounded (default 25s, npm 40s, -V 20s); ssh side bounded with ConnectTimeout
harness.encoding_note: this host console encoding is big5; omo.jsonc is decoded from raw bytes with explicit UTF-8 and the JSON file is written with UTF8Encoding($false), so no console transcoding occurs
